items.question: Which attendant deities must be worshipped alongside the invoked goddess?
premises: The preceding context prescribes invoking and worshipping the goddess with offerings.
Gaṇeśa and Baṭuka are named as objects of worship.
The Yoginīs and the field-guardian are also included.
items.inference: The ritual worship of the goddess includes Gaṇeśa, Baṭuka, the Yoginīs, and Kṣetrapālaka as attendant deities.
uncertainties: The governing verb of worship is supplied from the preceding verse.
items.plain_english: One should also worship Gaṇeśa, Baṭuka, the Yoginīs, and Kṣetrapālaka.
